text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Three metered wind farms W1 to W3; kept half-hours, true days 1 to 10 (lead 24 to 240 hours). Dot: estimate. Thick line: 95% interval. Thin line: 99.75% interval for the scored year (the second period shows 95% only). Intervals resample whole calendar months (scored year) or whole runs (later runs). Dashed line: same as default 2.'
text.tspan: Three metered wind farms W1 to W3; kept half-hours, true days 1 to 10 (lead 24 to 240 hours).
Dot: estimate. Thick line: 95% interval. Thin line: 99.75% interval for the scored year (the second
period shows 95% only). Intervals resample whole calendar months (scored year) or whole runs (later
runs). Dashed line: same as default 2.
